description: One trader's every metric displayable at a window (lifetime / 90d / 30d / 7d / 24h): the raw value and its percentile in that window's cohort — the cells a board ranked at that window scores. Give a wallet address or a masked tid. scope=combined (default) reads the multi-wallet user row as boards do. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY.

tid.description: Masked trader id from a public board (resolved with your key).

name: polyrank_get_trader_metrics
title: Polyrank trader metrics at a window
